name: PD 102 was established by Ordinance No. 15855, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1978. Ordinance No. 15855 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15855; 25423)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 102 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 102 was established by Ordinance No. 15855, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1978. Ordinance No. 15855 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 102 is established on property generally located along the east line of Golden Creek Road, north of Pineview Road and south of Cooper Creek Drive. The size of PD 102 is approximately 15.307 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-102.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in conformance with the development plan approved by the city plan commission and city council and labelled Exhibit 102A. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Main Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.105.MAIN USES. The only permitted uses in this district are fifty single-family zero lot line detached dwellings, a common open area, and a floodway management area. Within the common open area a lake with related access area is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to issuance of any building permits, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the county clerk. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.107.BUILDING SETBACKS. All buildings must be setback as indicated on the approved development plan. The front yard setback must be a minimum of 15 feet unless otherwise indicated on the development plan. Where automobile storage spaces are located in an enclosed structure so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street or alley, no such building may be located closer than 20 feet to any dedicated street or alley. No side yards are required but there must be a minimum of 10 feet between buildings. A minimum rear yard of five feet must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.108.LOT COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage is 45 percent of the total lot area. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.109.HEIGHT. No building may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.110.OFF-STREET PARKING. A minimum of two off-street parking spaces per dwelling must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.111.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business zoning district regulations in Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Street Dedication
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.112.STREET DEDICATION. All lots must be served by a dedicated street with a minimum right-of-way of 50 feet. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.113.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the permanent care and maintenance of the common area. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city as to legal form, and by the city plan commission as to suitability for the proposed use of the common area before the development plan will be approved. The instrument must be filed in the Deed Records of Dallas County, Texas, prior to the sale of any lot or tract. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. All development within this PD must be in conformance with all other codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-102.115.STREETS AND PAVING.
(a)All driveways, entrances, and dedicated streets must be constructed to the requirements of the department of public works and transportation.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.116.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15855; 25423)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-102.117.ZONING MAP. PD 102 is located on Zoning Map No. B-7. (Ord. 25423)
